name: Princess Holiday Ball at The Arts Hub
when_note: Saturday, December 19, 2026, three sessions: 10:30 AM, 1 PM and 3:30 PM
cost: General admission $35 per child and $20 per adult, VIP $45 per child and $30 per adult
paras: Imagine More Character Company brings its first annual Princess Holiday Ball to The Arts Hub Theatre at 420 Courtney Way in Lafayette on Saturday, December 19, 2026. Three sessions run at 10:30 AM, 1 PM and 3:30 PM, and each one features five princesses, including the Snow Sisters.

Each session has a 45-minute interactive performance with live singing, dancing and an indoor snowball fight, followed by 30 minutes to meet the princesses and take photos. General admission is $35 per child and $20 per adult. VIP tickets at $45 per child and $30 per adult add reserved seating in the first two rows, a tiara and hot chocolate, and a party must buy VIP together to sit together.
tip: Wear a princess dress or holiday outfit, and book VIP if your group wants to sit together near the stage.

name: Once Upon a Holiday Princess Ball and Concert
when_note: Sunday, December 13, 2026, two sessions: 10 to 11:45 AM and 3 to 4:45 PM
ages: All ages, parents stay with children
paras: Wands and Wishes Occasions hosts Once Upon a Holiday, a Holiday Princess Ball and Concert at The Chateaux at Fox Meadows, 13600 Xavier Lane in Broomfield, on Sunday, December 13, 2026. Choose the session from 10 to 11:45 AM or 3 to 4:45 PM and arrive 15 minutes early.

Professional princess singers in holiday attire perform live Christmas carols, and guests can dance and meet characters including Snow White, Cinderella, Elsa and Anna, plus a visit from Santa. Tickets are $60 for children, $40 for adults and $20 for infants under one, and everyone needs a ticket. A beverage station and light snacks are included, and add-ons include a $15 group portrait and a $25 tiara coronation.
tip: Photos are taken on your own device, so charge your phone and add the group portrait if you want all the princesses in one shot.
